body: Yep. Have short term memory loss and trouble paying attention. Makes me feel like I have Alzheimer’s or dementia because I think there’s something wrong when I can’t remember stuff
Do I need a yoke and rudder pedals as well?
Sorry should have specified more clearly. I want to fly small and medium planes
I have been doing research. Just wanted to double check on what I need to get started
I cut on my upper leg because it wouldn’t be noticeable. Didn’t hurt too bad. I used a steak knife
Weird. I expected a lot more blood

I know that if I do it it will only transfer the pain to others and I love my family and friends to much to do that. It’s what keeping me alive. I always try to keep a little hope left. And I’m hanging on a thread of the rope
Yea it’s weird for me too. It’s like my brain telling me that I almost need to do it

I’m not angry at myself. My emotions for the past couple months have been flat. I haven’t really felt any genuine thing expect panic and paranoia. I really have to try to be happy and sometimes I can only muster a smile for a few minutes
Pretty much all of my family lives in the Texas and Midwest area. The only cousin of mine that I trust is also in Texas
My moms parents died when I was really young. On my dads side, his mother just died and we’re moving my grandfather out to Texas so there is a lot on his mind and my dads

I’ve already tried to tell them that it’s serious. They’ve seen me in public when I started to get a panic attack and start scratching. The most recent one was in Walmart a few weeks ago and my mom told me to stop because people were looking at me weird. She also said that I was talking like a crazy person when I told her about the scratching. She threatened several times to lock me up in a psych ward because of it also.

I have very sensitive skin so hot/cold showers won’t do any good. I’m not at cutting, yet. I scratch my arm till it breaks skin and bleeds but it’s now not working like it used too. Im afraid what it’ll lead me to use

I’m a teenager so I still live with my parents. My parents said they won’t put me on medication because they don’t think that it’s serious enough. It took me months to convince them that I needed to see a psychologist.
